{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''senator''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] investigated the expansion of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] gang to determine its links with other crime syndicates. The investigation determined that Black Sun had expanded to multiple worlds beyond [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and found evidence of the group's struggle against [[Exchange]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Black Sun's Radiance}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Update 4.1. that changed the text of many Crew Skill missions to make them faction-neutral removed the mention of the Senator from this mission.
